results.reason: No trustless proof backend exists for the public old-root/prefix/new-root transition; proof bytes, proving time, verification time, RSS, and finalizer gas remain NOT_EVALUATED.
Queue enqueue gas alone cannot establish break-even; proof verification and batch settlement gas are required for every batch size.
The deterministic model oracle detects statement mutation but supplies no soundness, zero knowledge, PCS commitment, or verifier.
Canonical order blocks substitution and reordering but does not prevent a funded attacker from filling the queue and locking capital until timeout.
At low arrival rates, batches 64 and 256 produce long fill latency; permissionless timeout escape bounds withholding but sacrifices batching.
